verdict.rationale: The evidence shows two adjacent paths, and neither delivers this story. Developers can link a remote MCP server that already exposes an endpoint, or upload MCP server code for Metorial to host, which is a deployment. Nothing documents a tunnel, bridge, or local-agent mechanism that brings a locally running MCP server into the platform without deploying it.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bridge a locally running MCP server into the platform as a managed remote connection without deploying it
